WITH site_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(1.0 * m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS mesh_count
  FROM sites AS s
  LEFT JOIN scanmesh AS m
    ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_metrics
  WHERE insurstat IS NOT NULL
    AND avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY insurstat
), above_average AS (
  SELECT sm.insurstat, sm.avg_ratio, sa.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_metrics AS sm
  JOIN status_averages AS sa ON sa.insurstat = sm.insurstat
  WHERE sm.avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT
  insurstat,
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS above_average_sites_avg_ratio,
  COUNT(*) AS above_average_site_count,
  AVG(avg_ratio - status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_status_average
FROM above_average
GROUP BY insurstat;

assumptions.assumption: A site's average ratio averages only mesh records with a non-NULL resolution and a nonzero, non-NULL geometric accuracy; sites without such ratios do not contribute to their insurance status's site average. Mesh count includes all matched mesh records, including those without a usable ratio.
